</script><script>
'use strict';
const notes=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('notes-data').textContent),topics=[...new Set(notes.map(n=>n.disease))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b));
let view='home',selectedDisease=null,selectedNote=null,query='',hpiLoaded=false;
const el=id=>document.getElementById(id),safe=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
const counts={pages:notes.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b.pages||0),0),images:notes.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.illustrations,0),tables:notes.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.tables,0)};
el('packSummaryCount').textContent=`${topics.length} topics · ${notes.length} complete notes`;
el('stats').textContent=`${topics.length} topics · ${notes.length} complete note versions · ${counts.images} figures · ${counts.tables} tables`;
function show(viewname){view=viewname;el('home').classList.toggle('hide',view!=='home');el('hpiView').classList.toggle('hide',view!=='hpi');el('summaryView').classList.toggle('hide',view!=='summary');el('homeNav').textContent=view==='home'?'Home':'← Learn';
if(view==='hpi'&&!hpiLoaded){let str=el('hpi-source').textContent;const u=Uint8Array.from(atob(str),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));el('hpiFrame').srcdoc=new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(u);hpiLoaded=true;}
if(view==='summary'){el('summaryLayout').classList.remove('mobile-reading');renderTopics();if(!selectedDisease)selectTopic(topics[0],false)}window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
function relScore(n,q){const term=q.toLowerCase();const d=n.disease.toLowerCase(),l=n.label.toLowerCase();if(d.startsWith(term))return 100;if(d.includes(term))return 75;if(l.includes(term))return 55;if(n.searchtext.includes(term))return 15;return 0}
function renderTopics(){let keys=topics.map(name=>({name,rs:notes.filter(n=>n.disease===name),score:query?Math.max(...notes.filter(n=>n.disease===name).map(n=>relScore(n,query))):1})).filter(t=>!query||t.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.name.localeCompare(b.name));el('topicCount').textContent=keys.length;
el('diseaseList').innerHTML=keys.length?keys.map(t=>`<button class="disease ${selectedDisease===t.name?'active':''}" data-topic="${safe(t.name)}"><span class="diseaseicon"><svg width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 3H5v18h14V7l-4-4H8Z"/><path d="M8 11h8M8 15h8"/></svg></span><span class="diseasedesc"><b>${safe(t.name)}</b><small>${t.rs.length} ${t.rs.length===1?'version':'versions'}</small></span><span class="disease-chevron">›</span></button>`).join(''):'<p class="noTopics">No matching topics. Try a disease, symptom, or treatment term.</p>';
el('diseaseList').querySelectorAll('[data-topic]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>selectTopic(b.dataset.topic,true));
}
function selectTopic(d,scroll){selectedDisease=d;const ns=notes.filter(n=>n.disease===d);selectedNote=ns[0]?.id;renderTopics();renderDetail();if(scroll){el('summaryLayout').classList.add('mobile-reading');window.scrollTo({top:0})}}
function chooseVersion(id){selectedNote=id;renderDetail();window.scrollTo({top:0})}
function renderDetail(){const ns=notes.filter(n=>n.disease===selectedDisease),n=notes.find(x=>x.id===selectedNote)||ns[0];if(!n)return;const box=el('summaryDetail'),pageNum=n.pages||null;
box.innerHTML=`<button class="mobileback" id="mobileback">← All topics</button><div class="doc-header"><div class="breadcrumbs">DOCTOR SUMMARY &nbsp; › &nbsp; ${safe(n.disease)}</div><h2>${safe(n.disease)}</h2><div class="doc-kpis"><span><i>◦</i>${ns.length} ${ns.length===1?'note':'note versions'}</span><span><i>◦</i>${n.words.toLocaleString()} words</span>${pageNum?`<span><i>◦</i>${pageNum} pages</span>`:''}${n.tables?`<span><i>◦</i>${n.tables} tables</span>`:''}${n.illustrations?`<span><i>◦</i>${n.illustrations} figures</span>`:''}</div><nav class="tabs" aria-label="Note versions">${ns.map((v,i)=>`<button type="button" data-version="${safe(v.id)}" class="tab ${v.id===n.id?'active':''}">${ns.length>1?`0${i+1} · `:''}${safe(v.label)}</button>`).join('')}</nav></div><div class="reader-tools"><span class="reader-hint">Full clinical note · original text retained · scroll to read</span><div>${pageNum?`<label style="font-size:10px;color:#829087">Page&nbsp;<input id="pageNumber" class="select-page" inputmode="numeric" type="number" min="1" max="${pageNum}" value="1"></label> <button class="tinybutton" id="jumpPage" type="button">Go</button>`:''} <button class="tinybutton" id="topReader" type="button">↑ Top</button></div></div><details class="outline" id="outline"><summary>Browse sections in this note</summary><div class="outline-links" id="outlineLinks"></div></details><div class="reader" id="reader">${n.sections.map(s=>s.html).join('')}</div><div class="source-disclaimer">These notes reproduce the supplied educational material without updating or clinically reconciling the recommendations. Verify management guidance against current protocols before patient care.</div>`;
const heads=[...el('reader').querySelectorAll('h3')].filter(h=>h.textContent.trim().length>6).slice(0,100);heads.forEach((h,i)=>h.id='reader-section-'+i);el('outlineLinks').innerHTML=heads.map((h,i)=>`<button type="button" data-section="${i}">${safe(h.textContent.trim().slice(0,96))}</button>`).join('');el('outline').style.display=heads.length?'':'none';el('outlineLinks').querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{el('outline').open=false;el('reader').querySelector('#reader-section-'+b.dataset.section)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})});
box.querySelectorAll('[data-version]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>chooseVersion(b.dataset.version));el('mobileback').onclick=()=>{el('summaryLayout').classList.remove('mobile-reading');window.scrollTo(0,0)};el('topReader').onclick=()=>el('summaryView').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
if(pageNum
